windows.reason: Upstream icicle's host framework has no Windows support, and the obstacle is the operating system rather than the GPU. src/runtime.cpp uses POSIX dlopen/dlfcn.h and dirent.h for backend discovery and emits an explicit '#error Unsupported operating system' for anything that is not Linux or macOS; utils.h uses cxxabi.h for demangling, which has no Windows equivalent; test_base.h uses POSIX setenv. Confirmed independently on windows-gfx1151 (at d8e04fd) and on windows-gfx1201/gfx1101. The HIP GPU kernels themselves are correct and validated at head 2609ca44 on linux-gfx90a (wave64) and linux-gfx1100 (wave32); only the POSIX-only backend loader blocks Windows. Porting that loader to LoadLibrary/FindFirstFile is upstream-scope work well beyond this port's minimal footprint. Windows is the only gate not satisfied at head.

windows-gfx1201.blocked_reason: no-windows-support-in-icicle-host-framework: same blockers as windows-gfx1151 confirmed at d8e04fd -- runtime.cpp uses POSIX dlopen/dlfcn.h/dirent.h and emits #error Unsupported operating system for non-Linux/macOS; utils.h uses cxxabi.h (no Windows equivalent); test_base.h uses POSIX setenv. Upstream icicle framework missing Windows support; HIP-PQC GPU kernels are correct (validated on gfx90a and gfx1100).
